evidence_scope: R2 core RTL at 5ns target; no board calibration. Live E2 includes cold backend conversion/upload, compact readback, merge, downstream fill; no offline golden injection.

shared_context_comparison.interpretation: Four contexts alone regress; true dependence distances lower II20 to17, but shared global blocking memory still limits useful overlap. This scheduler is not an asynchronous request/response pipeline.

retained_simulator_warnings: Single-context HLS-generated floating-point DSP48E1 simulation emits repeated OPMODE warnings, retained unsuppressed in full logs (~11 MB each). Canonical fresh final outputs still match every native golden bit. No claim of general X-propagation absence is made.
